title: Identify the names and websites of exclusively virtual charter schools in t
question: Identify the names and websites of exclusively virtual charter schools in the county with the highest number of closed schools, where the school's free meal eligibility rate for students aged 5–17 exceeds 20%.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s.XCL_047, s.XCL_060
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
WHERE s.XCL_045 = (
    SELECT XCL_045
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_044 = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY XCL_045
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND s.XCL_063 = 1
AND s.XCL_076 = 'F'
AND CAST(f.XCL_025 AS REAL) / f.XCL_024 > 0.20

SELECT s.XCL_047, s.XCL_060
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
WHERE s.XCL_045 = (
    SELECT XCL_045
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_044 = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY XCL_045
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND s.XCL_063 = 1
AND s.XCL_076 = 'F'
AND CAST(f.XCL_025 AS REAL) / f.XCL_024 > 0.20
